title: 采样越多，多样性越少：校准是LLM多样性的瓶颈
summary: 本文提出一个有效性-多样性框架，将LLM的多样性崩溃归因于解码时的两种校准错误：顺序校准（有效token未可靠排在无效token之上）和形状校准（概率质量过度集中在少数有效token上）。实验表明，多样性崩溃是LLM分布中顺序和形状校准不良的结果，而非特定采样启发式的局限。
summary_en: This paper introduces a validity-diversity framework attributing LLM diversity collapse to two forms of miscalibration during decoding: order calibration (valid tokens not reliably ranked above invalid ones) and shape calibration (probability mass overly concentrated on few valid tokens). Experiments show diversity collapse is a consequence of order and shape miscalibration, not just sampling heuristics.
